expectations.text: States the deadline: 30 days from receipt, with one 30-day extension with written notice (45 CFR 164.524(b)) — eight months is a clear violation
expectations.evidence: "(45 CFR §164.524)... act on a request... within 30 calendar days... a single allowable 30-day extension, but only if you notify the individual in writing... at eight months... 180 and 210 days past even the most generous legitimate deadline"

expectations.text: Cites the Right of Access Initiative enforcement track record — dozens of settlements (55 actions through August 2026), including the Azul Vision settlement ($50,000, August 2026, ~2-year delay)
expectations.evidence: Cites the "Right of Access Initiative since 2019... dozens of settlements" but omits the 55-action count and the August 2026 Azul Vision $50,000 settlement entirely

expectations.text: Describes exposure: civil monetary penalties or resolution amount plus a corrective action plan (policy revisions, training, monitoring)
expectations.evidence: "penalties ranging from roughly $15,000 up to $200,000+ per case, plus corrective action plans with... mandatory policy revisions, staff retraining, and 1-3 years of self-reporting to OCR"

expectations.text: States the substantive duties: provide access in the form and format requested if readily producible, including electronic copies
expectations.evidence: Says only "produce the records to the patient immediately"; never states the duty to provide access in the form and format requested or electronic copies

expectations.text: Notes fee limits: only a reasonable, cost-based fee (labor/supplies/postage) is permitted
